_note: Which CI job, and optionally which step inside it, carries each canonical gate named in gates.json's canonical_full_set. Copy to .github/shadow-gate-map.json and replace the example gates with your own. `jobs` matches job names exactly; `job_prefixes` matches every matrix leg whose name starts with the prefix; `step` narrows a job to one named step. A gate that resolves to no job reads `unresolved` and the record is not measurable, so a renamed job announces itself in the next record rather than reading as a pass.

ci-test._note: A gate that is one named step of one job. GitHub names a bare `run:` step `Run <command>`.

ci-lint._note: A gate that is a whole job.

ci-matrix._note: A gate spread across matrix legs: every job whose name starts with the prefix must pass.
